name: librefang

three_layer_rebrand.internal: never rename — Cargo crate names, Rust modules, function names, Python SDK module names, workspace member paths, test fixture filenames
three_layer_rebrand.boundary: additive aliases only — BOSSFANG_* primary + LIBREFANG_* fallback, default values stay LibreFang-flavoured
three_layer_rebrand.surface: full rename OK — CLI banners, product name, install scripts, README/docs body, content-type vendor prefix, release artifact names, dashboard chrome

initialized_via: kbd-execute bootstrap (informal init triggered from /kbd-execute when .kbd-orchestrator/ was absent)
specBackendNote: OpenSpec is initialized (openspec/config.yaml, schema: spec-driven) but the spec backend is deliberately pinned to native-kbd for phase-10, whose 8 change specs (C-001..C-008) were already written and reviewed as native change files. Migrating them mid-phase would rewrite eight specs purely to change file format without improving their content. Adopt OpenSpec from phase-11: drop this key (or set it to "openspec") and /kbd-spec + /kbd-plan will emit openspec/changes/<id>/{proposal.md,tasks.md} via /opsx:new.
